answer: Each epoch the ledger hashes the seed with every address and flags five percent for a live spot audit: fresh words, a twenty-minute expiry, no cached text. The flagged set stays hidden until the seed publishes, so a farm cannot pre-staff it. One failed audit voids that epoch's emission for every identity sharing the funder. A thousand clones drawing twelve audits a day must wake someone at odd hours, about $3 of review each, a bill that outruns the drip. One ember of unannounced checking melts a glacier of scripts, and a nebula of free names goes cold when it must answer on demand.
